checkedAlternates.risk: Olive oil is a liquid plant oil.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Olive oil and avocado oil are pressed from fleshy fruit pulp (group-2), whereas sunflower, canola, sesame, and soybean are pressed from seeds/beans (group-4).
Coconut oil, palm oil, and cocoa butter are tropical saturated fats solid or semi-solid at cool room temperature (group-3), unlike liquid fruit-pulp oils (group-2).
